title: Blaqua Pack
description: A resource pack with funny damage sound and a cool new menu screen!
body:
This **very** **serious** resource pack contains funny damage sounds with a background made by Blaze Aqua that can be seen immediately upon applying the pack in the main menu/title screen of Minecraft: Java Edition!

What it does: When you take damage, you might hear a sound byte from the wonderful Spider-Man: The Animated Series Genesis track 'Fun House' and on the title screen you get a custom logo made by me on top of the vanilla panorama. As a bonus, you might hear some original music on the title screen too, which is also made by me!


Gameplay impact: none besides, hee hee funny damage ow and shiny new title screen! Perfect for those who just want something new, especially if you take damage a lot...
